# Brandon Caples

> Marketing automation specialist and web consultant with 10+ years designing lifecycle email campaigns, building complex audience segments, and improving performance through data-driven optimization — primarily in Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Also works as an independent consultant (Caples Web Consulting) building websites, email systems, and SEO/AEO-optimized content for small businesses and nonprofits.

## Resume
- [Marketing Automation Specialist Résumé](https://brandoncaples.com/resume/): Professional email marketing automation résumé — Salesforce Marketing Cloud, audience segmentation, lifecycle marketing, SQL, AMPscript.

## MarTech Blog
- [MarTech Blog](https://brandoncaples.com/martech/): Articles on marketing technology, email deployment and strategy, business analytics, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud implementation.
- [IP Address Warming](https://brandoncaples.com/martech/2023/ip-address-warming): How to warm a new sending IP address to protect email deliverability and sender reputation.
- [How to Query SFMC Subscribers Who Opened a Specific Email](https://brandoncaples.com/2024/how-to-query-subscribers-who-opened-sfmc-email): SQL query guide for identifying Salesforce Marketing Cloud subscribers who opened a given email.
- [Email Accessibility](https://brandoncaples.com/2024/email-accessibility): Best practices for building accessible HTML email campaigns.
- [Section 508 Email Compliance](https://brandoncaples.com/2023/section-508-email-compliance): Overview of Section 508 accessibility requirements as applied to email marketing.
- [UTM Parameters](https://brandoncaples.com/2023/utm-parameters): Guide to structuring and standardizing UTM tracking parameters for campaign attribution.
- [How to Develop a Marketing Campaign Strategy That Works](https://brandoncaples.com/2023/how-to-develop-marketing-campaign): Framework for planning and executing an effective marketing campaign strategy.
